metadata.description: Give Claude a video input. /watch downloads (with cookies for Instagram/X), extracts scene-change frames, microscopes the 0-10s hook, transcribes via captions or Whisper (API or fully local), and emits a structured report.

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path): YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Vimeo, Loom and more. Scene-change frames, 0-10s hook microscope, captions in the video's own language, Whisper via Groq/OpenAI or on-device (mlx-whisper / openai-whisper), browser cookies for login-gated sources, structured report.md, optional Obsidian auto-save.
